name: org.aimlds/conduit-router
title: Conduit Router — Governed MCP Routing
description: Governed MCP routing: every agent call spend-capped, metered, sealed with a verifiable receipt.

tools.name: route_chat
tools.description: Send a chat completion through Conduit Router: policy-checked, budget-checked, metered, and audit-receipted. Uses your own stored provider keys (BYOK). Pin a model as "provider:model" or let your standing terms choose.

model.description: Optional pin: "provider:model" (e.g. "groq:llama-3.3-70b-versatile"), "custom:<endpoint_id>:<model>", or a bare catalog model id.

messages.description: OpenAI-shaped messages: [{role, content}] with role system|user|assistant|tool.

task_profile.description: Optional routing profile: reasoning (deepest models), tool-use, or bulk (cheapest/fastest). Defaults to your standing terms.

max_tokens.description: Optional cap on the completion's output tokens.

tools.name: route_and_prove
tools.description: One call that composes route_chat + get_receipt + verify_receipt: routes a chat completion through the same policy, budget, and metering pipeline, then fetches the minted audit receipt and verifies it against the chain. Returns the completion (or the route failure — blocked and failed attempts are receipted too, and their receipts are proved the same way), the charge lines, the proof block, and an explicit not_proven list naming what the proof does not cover.

model.description: Optional pin: "provider:model" (e.g. "groq:llama-3.3-70b-versatile"), "custom:<endpoint_id>:<model>", or a bare catalog model id.

messages.description: OpenAI-shaped messages: [{role, content}] with role system|user|assistant|tool.

task_profile.description: Optional routing profile: reasoning (deepest models), tool-use, or bulk (cheapest/fastest). Defaults to your standing terms.

max_tokens.description: Optional cap on the completion's output tokens.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: The public model catalog: every model the router can serve, with provider, free-tier flag, task profiles, and pricing source/as-of.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Your cumulative meter (requests, tokens, provider cost, router charge), today's spend against your daily budget, and which providers you have keys stored for.

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: One of your calls' audit receipts (id like "rcpt_12") with its hash-chain proof: record hash validity, successor linkage, and the current chain head.

receipt_id.description: The receipt id from a routed call, e.g. "rcpt_12".

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Cryptographically verify a receipt record (yours or anyone's) against the router's audit chain: the record hash must recompute and the stored record at that sequence must match.

receipt.description: The full audit record object from a receipt.

tools.name: get_policy
tools.description: Your key's standing terms (mandate): task profile, per-request and daily budgets, model allowlist, fallback chain, region — plus kill-switch state.
